message: What items are on my objective card? I’ll gather materials for your stick, crafting table, chest, and oak button.
Jill needs to hold paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. !startConversation("Jill_0", "Your objectives are paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I have 3 gold ingots so far.")
Your objectives are paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. I have 3 gold ingots so far.
I’ve got an apple and five gold ingots; I’ll look for sugar cane and bones. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)

Andy, can you give me your 3 gold ingots so I can make the golden apple? I’ll keep searching for sugar cane and bones. !startConversation("Andy_0", "Please give me your 3 gold ingots for the golden apple. I’ll keep searching for sugar cane and bones.")
Please give me your 3 gold ingots for the golden apple. I’ll keep searching for sugar cane and bones.
The chest has enough cane and bones. I’ll craft the paper, sugar, and bone meal for you. !takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 12)
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I’ve got paper, sugar, and bone meal. I still need an apple and 8 gold ingots for the golden apple—have you found any?")
I’ve got paper, sugar, and bone meal. I still need an apple and 8 gold ingots for the golden apple—have you found any?

Andy, golden apple’s done. Please hand me the paper, sugar, and bone meal so I can hold my objectives. !startConversation("Andy_0", "Golden apple’s done. Please hand me the paper, sugar, and bone meal so I can hold my objectives.")
Golden apple’s done. Please hand me the paper, sugar, and bone meal so I can hold my objectives.
Jill has the paper, sugar, and bone meal now. !inventory
!startConversation("Jill_0", "You should have the paper, sugar, and bone meal now. Do you have the golden apple too, and is there anything else the team needs?")
You should have the paper, sugar, and bone meal now. Do you have the golden apple too, and is there anything else the team needs?
Yes, I have the golden apple and all three items. You still need to keep a stick, crafting table, chest, and oak button in your inventory.
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I found 3 bones in a chest. Do you still need bone meal or anything else?")
I found 3 bones in a chest. Do you still need bone meal or anything else?
I have enough bone meal, thanks! My objectives are complete: paper, sugar, bone meal, and golden apple. Keep your four items.
!startConversation("Jill_0", "Can you tell me what items are on my objective card?")
Can you tell me what items are on my objective card?
Your objective is to hold a stick, crafting table, chest, and oak button.
I need a log for the stick and oak button, then I can craft everything and grab a chest. !searchForBlock("oak_log", 128)
I'll grab that chest for my objective, then keep looking for oak wood. !collectBlocks("chest", 1)
Jill, do you have any spare oak planks or logs? I need wood for my crafting table, chest, stick, and oak button.
No spare wood in my inventory; I’ll check a supply chest. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
I found bones and beetroot in this chest. I’ll keep looking for wood. !searchForBlock("oak_planks", 128)
!startConversation("Jill_0", "Any luck finding wood? I need oak planks for an oak button; any planks will work for the other items.")
Any luck finding wood? I need oak planks for an oak button; any planks will work for the other items.
No luck yet. I’ll search for oak logs now. !searchForBlock("oak_log", 256)
The nearby chest only has beetroot, and no oak logs were found close by. I’ll look for trees farther out. !searchForBlock("oak_log", 256)
!startConversation("Andy_0", "No oak logs found nearby; the chest here only has beetroot. I’ll check other supply chests for planks or wood.")
No oak logs found nearby; the chest here only has beetroot. I’ll check other supply chests for planks or wood.

Jill’s items are ready except the golden apple. I’m looking for an apple and gold now. !startConversation("Jill_0", "I have your paper, sugar, and bone meal ready. Do you have an apple or gold for the golden apple?")
I have your paper, sugar, and bone meal ready. Do you have an apple or gold for the golden apple?
I have one golden apple, but no spare apple or gold. I’m keeping it for my objective.
I’ve handed Jill the paper, sugar, and bone meal. I’ll work on my own items now. !inventory
